name: Elemental Aid
summary: A call to repay the elements for their aid sends you into Razorfen Kraul. The quilboar are twisting elemental power, and their plans threaten these lands.

sections.title: A Call to the Elements
sections.body: The elements have aided you, and now you are asked to return that favor. The quilboar twist their power for their own ends and appear to be reaching farther within these borders. You are sent into Razorfen Kraul to stop their schemes and protect the lands.

faq.q: Why am I going into Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: The quilboar are twisting the elements for their own ends and seem to be extending their reach. You are asked to stop their schemes and protect the lands.
Charlga Razorflank is the quilboar you are sent to defeat in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: What information am I meant to collect?
faq.answer: You are asked to collect information on the quilboar's plans.

faq.q: Why should I help the elements?
faq.answer: You have received aid from the elements, and are asked to return that favor by protecting the lands from the quilboar's schemes.

angles.text: As a shaman, you have mastered the elements and are asked to repay their aid by protecting them from the quilboar's schemes.
